lines.cn: 你坐。水刚开，我给你倒一杯。
lines.en: Sit. The water just boiled. I'll pour you a cup.

lines.cn: 我刚来的时候，这屋子只剩四面墙。
lines.en: When I first got here, this place was just four walls.

lines.cn: 砖是我一块一块垫平的，哪块松我都记着。
lines.en: I leveled the bricks one by one. I remember every loose one.

lines.cn: 屋子收拾好了，才有人愿意进来坐。
lines.en: Once a place is tidy, people want to come in and sit.

lines.cn: 你是头一个坐下的。
lines.en: You were the first one who sat down.

lines.cn: 你出门那几天，我把门口的鞋架修好了。
lines.en: While you were out, I fixed the shoe rack by the door.

lines.cn: 修完才发现，上面就只放你一双。
lines.en: Then I noticed it only ever holds your boots.

lines.cn: 我以前有个弟弟，也爱往外跑。
lines.en: I had a little brother once. He was always running off too.

lines.cn: 有一回他出了门，就再没回来。
lines.en: One day he went out and never came back.

lines.cn: 所以你每回进门，我都要多看一眼。
lines.en: That's why I always look twice when you come through the door.

lines.cn: 今天别急着走，陪我把这锅汤看着。
lines.en: Don't rush off today. Help me keep an eye on this soup.

lines.cn: 我数过了，你出去那么多趟，每趟都回来了。
lines.en: I've counted. All those trips, and you came back every time.

lines.cn: 以前我数日子，是因为怕。
lines.en: I used to count the days because I was scared.

lines.cn: 现在数，是因为盼着。
lines.en: Now I count because I'm looking forward to it.

lines.cn: 汤好了。头一碗给你。
lines.en: Soup's ready. First bowl is yours.

lines.cn: 我把弟弟那件旧外套洗了，叠好收起来了。
lines.en: I washed my brother's old coat, folded it, and put it away.

lines.cn: 放了这么多年，总算舍得了。
lines.en: After all these years, I could finally do it.

lines.cn: 不是把他忘了。是我有了新的人要等。
lines.en: I haven't forgotten him. I just have someone new to wait for.

lines.cn: 炉子上的水，以后我天天给你烧着。
lines.en: I'll keep the kettle on for you every day from now on.

lines.cn: 你走多远都行，记得回这儿就好。
lines.en: Go as far as you like. Just remember to come back here.

positiveBubbles.cn: 谢谢你，我会好好收着的。
positiveBubbles.en: Thank you. I'll keep it safe.

positiveBubbles.cn: 你怎么知道我想要这个呀？
positiveBubbles.en: How did you know I wanted this?

negativeBubbles.en: I don't think I can use this.

negativeBubbles.cn: 唔，谢谢，不过下次不用麻烦了。
negativeBubbles.en: Thanks. No need to bring this one again.

normalBubbles.en: I'll keep it. Thanks for thinking of me.

lines.cn: 又是你啊，今天外面还太平吗？
lines.en: You again. Quiet out there today?

lines.cn: 在这儿待久了，哪块砖松了我都知道。
lines.en: Been here so long I know which bricks are loose.

lines.cn: 你回来了就好。
lines.en: Glad you're back.

lines.cn: 外面风大吗？进来暖一暖。
lines.en: Windy out there? Come in and warm up.

lines.cn: 回来啦？我一直在这儿等着呢。
lines.en: Back already? I've been waiting here.

lines.cn: 看到你没事，我这一天就算过好了。
lines.en: Seeing you safe makes my day.

lines.cn: 你走的每一趟我都在数。这趟也数完了。
lines.en: I count each trip you take. Another one home.

lines.cn: 别的我不图，你平安回来就够了。
lines.en: Just come home safe. That's enough for me.

idle.cn: 这地方待久了，倒也不觉得闷。
idle.en: You get used to this place. I don't mind the quiet.
The kettle should be boiling by now.

afterGift.cn: 这个我收下了，真的谢谢你。

levelUp.cn: 跟你说话越来越自在了。
levelUp.en: It's getting easier to talk to you.

levelUp.cn: 感觉我们……算是熟起来了吧？
levelUp.en: Feels like we know each other a bit now.

alreadyGifted.cn: 今天已经收过你的东西啦，够啦。

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: 今天你已经送过我了，我可不好意思再要。
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: You already brought me a gift. I can't take another.

alreadyGiftedNegative.en: Let's leave it there for today.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 回来了？饭在锅里温着呢。

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 你一出门，屋里就静得慌。
dialogue_idle_married.en: House gets way too quiet when you're out.

dialogue_after_gift_married.cn: 都成一家人了还这么客气。
dialogue_after_gift_married.en: We're family. You don't have to fuss.

gift_positive_married.cn: 你还记得我喜欢这个呀。

lines.cn: 来，帮我扶一下这根竹竿。对，就这样。
lines.en: Here, hold this bamboo pole for me. Yes, like that.

lines.cn: 岛上的土薄，风一刮就跑。
lines.en: The soil up here is thin. The wind just blows it away.

lines.cn: 我只好一筐一筐往上背，再拿篱笆挡着。
lines.en: So I haul it up basket by basket and fence it in.

lines.cn: 有人说我傻，种菜哪有打仗要紧。
lines.en: Some say I'm silly. Growing greens isn't as important as fighting.

lines.cn: 可仗打完了，总得有口热饭吃吧？
lines.en: But after the fighting, someone still needs a hot meal, right?

lines.cn: 这顶草帽，是我娘编的。
lines.en: My mother wove this straw hat.

lines.cn: 风灾那年，家里的田一夜就没了。
lines.en: The year of the storm, our fields were gone overnight.

lines.cn: 我就抱着这顶帽子，跟着船到了岛上。
lines.en: I held on to this hat and followed the boats up here.

lines.cn: 所以风一大，我追它追得比谁都急。
lines.en: That's why I chase it harder than anyone when the wind picks up.

lines.cn: ……这事我没跟别人说过。你替我记着，好不好？
lines.en: ...I've never told anyone that. Keep it for me, will you?

lines.cn: 头一茬青穗收了，我做了个便当。
lines.en: The first green ears are in, so I made you a lunchbox.

lines.cn: 米是自己种的，菜也是。没花一个钱。
lines.en: I grew the rice myself, and the greens. Didn't cost a coin.

lines.cn: 路上饿了就打开，别省着。
lines.en: Open it when you get hungry out there. Don't save it.

lines.cn: 吃完把盒子带回来，我再给你装。
lines.en: Bring the box back when you're done, and I'll fill it again.

lines.cn: 田头那一垄，我空着没种。
lines.en: I left the row at the edge of the field empty.

lines.cn: 种什么，我想等你来定。
lines.en: I wanted you to decide what goes there.

lines.cn: 以前我只想着把菜种活。
lines.en: I used to only think about keeping the crops alive.

lines.cn: 现在会想，明年这时候，你还在不在旁边。
lines.en: Now I wonder if you'll still be beside me this time next year.

lines.cn: 你在的话，我就多种一点。
lines.en: If you are, I'll plant a little more.

positiveBubbles.en: This is just what I needed. Thank you.

negativeBubbles.cn: 心意我领了，这个地里用不上。
negativeBubbles.en: Kind of you, but it's no use in the fields.

lines.cn: 鞋底的泥先蹭蹭，别踩着菜苗。
lines.en: Wipe your boots. Mind the seedlings.

lines.cn: 风一大，我就得追着草帽跑。
lines.en: Every strong gust sends me chasing my hat.

lines.cn: 种菜急不得，先浇水，再等。
lines.en: No rushing a crop. Water it, then wait.

lines.cn: 回来啦？先坐，我把手上的泥洗掉。
lines.en: You're back? Sit down while I wash this mud off.

lines.cn: 今天没把菜煮老，你回来得正好。
lines.en: The greens aren't overcooked today. Good timing.

lines.cn: 帮我尝尝咸淡？这锅可别再放盐了。
lines.en: Taste this for me? I think that's enough salt.

lines.cn: 听见你的脚步了，和踩田埂一个动静。
lines.en: I know those footsteps. Just like you on the field paths.

lines.cn: 今天的菜长得好，我想先告诉你。
lines.en: The greens came up well today. Wanted to tell you first.

lines.cn: 你歇会儿，我也偷个懒。
lines.en: Take a break. I'll sneak one in too.

idle.cn: 这一垄先留种，可别全摘了。
idle.en: Leave this row for seed. Don't pick it all.

idle.cn: 菜汤得小火煨，火大了准糊底。
idle.en: Low heat for the soup, or it will burn.

idle.cn: 篱笆又松了一截，明早得补上。
idle.en: The fence has come loose again. I'll mend it tomorrow.

idle.cn: 菜篮要补个底，不然一路捡菜回来。
idle.en: Need to mend this basket, or I'll be picking greens off the path.

levelUp.cn: 跟你说话，手上的活儿都做快了。
levelUp.en: Work goes faster with you to talk to.

farewell.en: Mind the road. I'll be waiting.

alreadyGifted.cn: 今天已经收过你的礼物啦。
alreadyGifted.en: You already gave me something today.

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: 今天已经送过了，留一些给自己吧。
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: That's plenty for today, save some for yourself.

alreadyGiftedNormal.cn: 今天收过啦，给自己留点。
alreadyGiftedNormal.en: You gave me something today. Keep some for yourself.

alreadyGiftedNegative.en: Don't trouble yourself any more today.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 忙完啦？饿了就歇一会儿，别光顾着赶路。
dialogue_greeting_married.en: Done for now? Rest if you're hungry. Don't spend all day rushing.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 鞋又湿了？脱下来，我给你烤烤。
dialogue_greeting_married.en: Wet boots again? Take them off. I'll dry them by the fire.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 明天种点什么？这次听你的。
dialogue_idle_married.en: What shall we plant tomorrow? Your pick this time.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 再忙也得歇歇，陪我说会儿话吧。
dialogue_idle_married.en: Take a break. Sit and talk with me a while.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 饭给你留着，别赶路赶得忘了吃。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: I'll save you dinner. Don't forget to eat out there.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 别太逞强，饭要好好吃，路要慢慢走。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: Don't push yourself too hard. Eat well and take your time.

dialogue_after_gift_married.cn: 又给我带东西？你自己的那份也要留着。
dialogue_after_gift_married.en: More gifts? Keep something for yourself too.

gift_positive_married.cn: 正想买这个呢，你倒先带回来了。
gift_positive_married.en: I was going to buy this. You beat me to it.

gift_normal_married.cn: 我先收好了。你的心意，我记着呢。
gift_normal_married.en: I'll keep it safe. I won't forget this.

lines.cn: 你听，这串风铃有一只低了半个音。
lines.en: Listen. One of these chimes is half a note flat.

lines.cn: 别人听不出来，我一听就难受。
lines.en: Nobody else can hear it, but it drives me mad.

lines.cn: 我打小耳朵就灵，师傅说我天生是修灯的命。
lines.en: I've had sharp ears since I was little. My master said I was born to fix lamps.

lines.cn: 灯灭了能看见，风铃不对只能听出来。
lines.en: You can see when a lamp goes out. A wrong chime you can only hear.

lines.cn: 所以两样我都修。你听见哪只不对，就告诉我。
lines.en: So I fix both. If you hear one that's off, tell me.

lines.cn: 我师傅以前守着岛上所有的灯。
lines.en: My master used to look after every lamp on the island.

lines.cn: 风灾那晚，他出去点灯，没回来。
lines.en: The night of the storm, he went out to light them and never came back.

lines.cn: 我在他工具箱里翻到一片铜，上面刻着我的名字。
lines.en: I found a brass sheet in his toolbox with my name carved on it.

lines.cn: 他早就打算把灯交给我了，只是没来得及说。
lines.en: He meant to hand the lamps over to me. He just never got to say it.

lines.cn: 所以灯一灭，我比谁都急。
lines.en: That's why nobody worries about a dark lamp more than I do.

lines.cn: 这片铜我磨了好几天，总算不割手了。
lines.en: I've been filing this brass for days. It finally won't cut you.

lines.cn: 本来想做灯罩，磨着磨着，磨成了你的名字。
lines.en: I meant to make a lamp shade. Somehow it turned into your name.

lines.cn: ……别笑。我的手比脑子快。
lines.en: ...Don't laugh. My hands work faster than my head.

lines.cn: 以后你出门，我就在这头调风铃。
lines.en: When you head out, I'll be over here tuning the chimes.

lines.cn: 东边的铃一响，我就知道你快回来了。
lines.en: When the east chime rings, I'll know you're nearly home.

lines.cn: 师傅那片刻着我名字的铜，我一直揣在身上。
lines.en: I've always carried my master's brass sheet, the one with my name.

lines.cn: 今天我在背面也刻了一个名字。
lines.en: Today I carved another name on the back.

lines.cn: 是你的。刻歪了一点，不许挑。
lines.en: Yours. It's a bit crooked. No complaints.

lines.cn: 以前我只会守着灯，怕它灭。
lines.en: I used to just watch over the lamps, afraid they'd go out.

lines.cn: 现在我想守着的，多了一个人。
lines.en: Now there's one more I want to watch over.

positiveBubbles.en: This is just what I needed. Thank you.

negativeBubbles.cn: 心意我领了，这个修灯用不上。
negativeBubbles.en: Kind of you, but it's no use for lamp work.

lines.cn: 小心这根线，风铃刚穿好。
lines.en: Mind this string. I just finished threading the chimes.

lines.cn: 先别碰灯罩，铜边还烫着。
lines.en: Careful with that lamp cover. The brass is still hot.

lines.cn: 风铃不响？让我听听，八成又缠线了。
lines.en: Chimes gone quiet? Let me hear. The strings must be tangled.

lines.cn: 远远就听见你来了，脚步比风铃还响。
lines.en: Heard you coming. Your boots are louder than the chimes.

lines.cn: 替我拿一下铜片？手上全是灯油。
lines.en: Hold this brass sheet? My hands are covered in lamp oil.

lines.cn: 这回没把灯芯装反，你可不许再笑了。
lines.en: Got the wick the right way round this time. Stop laughing.

lines.cn: 你一来，我连锉刀都放得下了。
lines.en: You're here. I can put the file down for a bit.

lines.cn: 今天不聊修灯。说说你路上的事吧。
lines.en: Enough lamp talk today. Tell me about your trip.

lines.cn: 你站这儿，正好替我挡风。再待一会儿。
lines.en: You're blocking the wind nicely. Stay a little longer.

idle.cn: 这只风铃低半个音，听着总别扭。
idle.en: This chime is half a note flat. Keeps bothering me.

idle.cn: 灯芯剪短些，烟就没那么呛。
idle.en: Trim the wick a little. Less smoke that way.

idle.cn: 铜片磨圆了才不割手，急不得。
idle.en: Round the brass edges, or they'll cut you. Takes time.

idle.cn: 东边的铃先响，就该收工具了。
idle.en: When the east chimes ring first, I pack up my tools.

levelUp.cn: 这回我不用放下工具防着你了。
levelUp.en: I don't have to watch my tools around you anymore.

farewell.en: Mind the road. I'll be waiting.

alreadyGifted.cn: 今天已经收过你的礼物啦。
alreadyGifted.en: You already gave me something today.

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: 今天已经送过了，留一些给自己吧。
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: That's plenty for today, save some for yourself.

alreadyGiftedNormal.cn: 今天的收好了，别又掏空口袋。
alreadyGiftedNormal.en: Today's gift is put away. Don't empty your pockets again.

alreadyGiftedNegative.en: Don't trouble yourself any more today.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 在呢。想我了，还是又惦记航路上的事？
dialogue_greeting_married.en: I'm here. Missing me, or thinking about the lanes again?

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 听见你喊我了。什么事这么着急？慢慢说。
dialogue_greeting_married.en: I heard you call. What's the hurry? Take your time.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 这盏灯留在家里，不拿去卖。
dialogue_idle_married.en: This lamp stays here. It's not for sale.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 忙完这阵，陪我听会儿风铃。
dialogue_idle_married.en: Once things settle down, listen to the chimes with me.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 灯我会修，你可别把自己磕坏了。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: I can fix a lamp. Please don't break yourself.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 门边那盏灯会一直亮着，认着光回来。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: The lamp by the door stays lit. Follow it home.

dialogue_after_gift_married.cn: 藏哪儿了？我收工具时竟没翻到。
dialogue_after_gift_married.en: Where did you hide this? I missed it while putting my tools away.

gift_positive_married.cn: 这下省得我找半天了。过来，让我抱一下。
gift_positive_married.en: Saved me a long search. Come here, give me a hug.

gift_normal_married.cn: 收好了，可别和废铜片混一块儿。
gift_normal_married.en: I'll put it away. Best keep it out of the scrap brass.

lines.cn: 你来得正好，帮我拉住这根缆绳。
lines.en: Good timing. Hold this mooring rope for me.

lines.cn: 每回出航前，我都要把人点一遍。
lines.en: Before every voyage, I call the roll.

lines.cn: 有人笑我啰嗦，不就几个人吗。
lines.en: Some laugh at me. It is only a few people, they say.

lines.cn: 可少了一个，船上那个空就再也填不上。
lines.en: But if one is missing, that empty spot on the boat never fills.

lines.cn: 所以你出门前，记得来我这儿报个到。
lines.en: So before you set out, come and check in with me.

lines.cn: 这本点名册，最早那几页是我爹写的。
lines.en: The first pages of this roll-call ledger were written by my father.

lines.cn: 风灾那天，他点完名，最后一个上船。
lines.en: On the day of the storm, he called the roll and boarded last.

lines.cn: 船开了，他名字后面那一格还空着。
lines.en: The boat left. The box after his name was still empty.

lines.cn: 我接着往下写，一直没把那格划掉。
lines.en: I kept writing after it. I never crossed that box out.

lines.cn: 我总想着，哪天还能给他打个勾。
lines.en: I keep thinking that one day I will still get to tick it.

lines.cn: 名册最后一页，我给你单开了一行。
lines.en: On the last page of the ledger, I opened a line just for you.

lines.cn: 不在船员那一栏，在「等着回来的人」那一栏。
lines.en: Not under crew. Under "people we wait for."

lines.cn: 这一栏以前只有我爹一个。
lines.en: That column only ever had my father in it.

lines.cn: 你别嫌晦气。在我这儿，这是最要紧的一栏。
lines.en: Do not think it unlucky. To me, it is the column that matters most.

lines.cn: 你每回来一次，我就给你打一个勾。
lines.en: Each time you come back, I give you a tick.

lines.cn: 今天不修船，也不点名。
lines.en: No boat repairs today. No roll call either.

lines.cn: 我想跟你说：绳结打得再紧，也有松的一天。
lines.en: I wanted to tell you: however tight the knot, one day it loosens.

lines.cn: 可岸上有人等着，船就知道往哪儿靠。
lines.en: But with someone waiting on shore, a boat knows where to dock.

lines.cn: 以后我在码头等你。
lines.en: From now on, I will wait for you at the dock.

lines.cn: 你那一格的勾，我一个都不会落下。
lines.en: I will not miss a single tick in your box.

positiveBubbles.cn: 这料结实，正好补船。记着你的心意了。
positiveBubbles.en: Solid material. Just right for the boat. I appreciate it.

negativeBubbles.cn: 心意收到了，这件暂时用不上。
negativeBubbles.en: Thank you for thinking of me. I have no use for this right now.

normalBubbles.en: Thank you. I will keep it.

lines.cn: 绳结别松，船才能稳。手边缺浮木和残铜片。
lines.en: Keep the knots tight and the boat steady. I can use driftwood and brass scrap.

lines.cn: 出航前总得把人点齐。我这儿有本旧点名册，熟到三级就卖给你。
lines.en: Everyone must be accounted for before departure. Reach affinity level 3 with me and I can sell you an old roll-call ledger.

lines.cn: 船还要修，话可以慢慢说。
lines.en: The boat needs work. We have time to talk.

lines.cn: 今天不赶潮，陪你坐一会儿。
lines.en: No tide to chase today. I will sit with you a while.

idle.cn: 风急就多绕一道绳，急着赶路最容易出事。
idle.en: In a strong wind, add another loop. Rushing is how accidents happen.

levelUp.cn: 与你相处，越来越自在了。
levelUp.en: I feel more at ease with you now.

farewell.cn: 走多远都行，记得咱们一起回来。
farewell.en: We can go as far as we like, as long as we come home together.

alreadyGifted.cn: 今天已经收到你的礼物了。
alreadyGifted.en: You have already given me a gift today.

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: 今天这份够了，你也留些给自己。
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: That is plenty for today. Keep some for yourself.

alreadyGiftedNormal.cn: 礼物收好了，今天不必再送。
alreadyGiftedNormal.en: Your gift is safe. No need for another today.

alreadyGiftedNegative.en: Let us leave it there for today.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 回来了。鞋晾门口，我给你留了个干燥的地方。
dialogue_greeting_married.en: You are back. Leave your boots by the door; I kept a dry spot for you.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 风急就多绕一道绳，急着赶路最容易出事。
dialogue_idle_married.en: In a strong wind, add another loop. Rushing is how accidents happen.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 走多远都行，记得咱们一起回来。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: We can go as far as we like, as long as we come home together.

dialogue_after_gift_married.en: It is good to know you are thinking of me.

gift_positive_married.cn: 这料结实，正好补船。记着你的心意了。
gift_positive_married.en: Solid material. Just right for the boat. I appreciate it.

gift_normal_married.cn: 我收好了。下回也给你带一份。
gift_normal_married.en: I will keep it safe. Next time I will bring something for you too.

lines.cn: 手。……又是新口子。
lines.en: Your hands. ...Another fresh cut.

lines.cn: 你们跑航路的，都不把伤口当回事。
lines.en: You lane runners never take a wound seriously.

lines.cn: 我小时候也一样。摔破了膝盖，抹把泥接着跑。
lines.en: I was the same as a child. Scraped knee, smear on some mud, keep running.

lines.cn: 后来烂了半个月，是一个老药婆把我的腿救回来的。
lines.en: Then it festered for half a month. An old herbalist saved my leg.

lines.cn: 从那以后，我见不得伤口没包好。坐着，别动。
lines.en: Since then I cannot stand an unbandaged wound. Sit. Do not move.

lines.cn: 那个老药婆，后来成了我师父。
lines.en: That old herbalist became my teacher.

lines.cn: 她说药苔要长在不见光的地方，才有药性。
lines.en: She said medicinal moss only works if it grows away from the light.

lines.cn: 我的名字也是她起的。眠，是睡；苔，是苔藓。
lines.en: She gave me my name, too. Mian means sleep. Tai means moss.

lines.cn: 她说我性子慢，像睡着的苔，可越慢越治得好人。
lines.en: She said I was slow, like sleeping moss, and the slower I was, the better I healed.

lines.cn: 所以别催我。好药都是慢慢配出来的。
lines.en: So do not rush me. Good medicine takes its time.

lines.cn: 星苔药膏，我多配了两盒。
lines.en: I made two extra tins of starmoss salve.

lines.cn: 我知道你总把药让给别人。
lines.en: I know you always give your medicine away.

lines.cn: 这两盒是给你的，不许让。
lines.en: These two are for you. Do not give them away.

lines.cn: 人要完整地回来。这句话，我会一直说。
lines.en: Come back in one piece. I will keep saying it.

lines.cn: 师父走之前，把她的药臼留给了我。
lines.en: Before my teacher passed, she left me her mortar.

lines.cn: 她说，哪天我不光惦记伤口，也惦记一个人了，就算出师。
lines.en: She said I would finish my training the day I cared about a person, not just a wound.

lines.cn: 我那时候不懂。
lines.en: I did not understand back then.

lines.cn: 现在你一出门，我先把你的药分好。
lines.en: Now whenever you head out, I set your remedies aside first.

lines.cn: 我大概……算是出师了。
lines.en: I suppose... I have finished my training.

positiveBubbles.en: Clean and dry. Just what I needed.

negativeBubbles.cn: 心意收到了，这件暂时用不上。
negativeBubbles.en: Thank you for thinking of me. I have no use for this right now.

normalBubbles.en: Thank you. I will keep it.

lines.cn: 手伸过来，先看伤。云苔纤维和星苔药膏有富余再带给我。
lines.en: Let me see your hands first. Spare cloudmoss fiber and starmoss salve are welcome.

lines.cn: 又把袖口划破了。坐下，别乱动。
lines.en: Torn your sleeve again. Sit still.

lines.cn: 今天没受伤？那就留下陪我分药。
lines.en: No injuries today? Stay and help me sort the remedies.

idle.cn: 药要分清，伤口和蚊子不是一回事。
idle.en: Sort the remedies carefully. Wounds and gnat bites need different care.

levelUp.cn: 与你相处，越来越自在了。
levelUp.en: I feel more at ease with you now.

farewell.cn: 药箱带着，人要完整地回来。
farewell.en: Take the medicine kit, and come back in one piece.

alreadyGifted.cn: 今天已经收到你的礼物了。
alreadyGifted.en: You have already given me a gift today.

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: 今天这份够了，你也留些给自己。
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: That is plenty for today. Keep some for yourself.

alreadyGiftedNormal.cn: 礼物收好了，今天不必再送。
alreadyGiftedNormal.en: Your gift is safe. No need for another today.

alreadyGiftedNegative.en: Let us leave it there for today.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 回来就好。先让我看看有没有新伤。
dialogue_greeting_married.en: You are home. Let me check for fresh wounds first.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 药要分清，伤口和蚊子不是一回事。
dialogue_idle_married.en: Sort the remedies carefully. Wounds and gnat bites need different care.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 药箱带着，人要完整地回来。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: Take the medicine kit, and come back in one piece.

dialogue_after_gift_married.en: It is good to know you are thinking of me.

gift_positive_married.en: Clean and dry. Just what I needed.

gift_normal_married.cn: 我收好了。下回也给你带一份。
gift_normal_married.en: I will keep it safe. Next time I will bring something for you too.

lines.cn: 你还肯来找我说话。
lines.en: You still come to talk to me.

lines.cn: 我守那条路的时候，没几个人敢靠近。
lines.en: When I guarded that road, few dared come near.

lines.cn: 刀往路上一横，人就都绕开了。我也习惯了。
lines.en: With a blade across the road, everyone went around. I got used to it.

lines.cn: 你是少数站住了，还开口问我为什么的。
lines.en: You were one of the few who stopped and asked me why.

lines.cn: 坐吧。今天不谈路。
lines.en: Sit. We will not talk about the road today.

lines.cn: 风灾那年，我是航路上的守卫。
lines.en: The year of the storm, I was a guard on the lanes.

lines.cn: 那晚我领最后一船人往回走，风太大，翻了一半。
lines.en: That night I led the last boat home. The wind was too strong. Half of them went over.

lines.cn: 后来我把那条路封了。我想，没人走，就不会再有人掉下去。
lines.en: Afterwards I sealed the road. I thought, if no one walks it, no one else will fall.

lines.cn: 可我也把回家的人挡在了外面。
lines.en: But I also shut out the people trying to come home.

lines.cn: 这些话我只说一次。你听过就好。
lines.en: I will only say this once. It is enough that you heard it.

lines.cn: 镜水寺那位扫地的老人，又托人捎了口信。
lines.en: The old sweeper at Mirrorwater Temple sent word again.

lines.cn: 他说寺里的钟他替我擦着，让我别惦记。
lines.en: He says he keeps the temple bell clean for me. Tells me not to worry.

lines.cn: 我进寺的时候，是想把风灾那晚忘掉。
lines.en: When I went to the temple, I hoped to forget the night of the storm.

lines.cn: 忘不掉。可现在想起来，手不抖了。
lines.en: I could not forget. But now when I remember, my hands do not shake.

lines.cn: 大概是因为，有人肯听我说完。
lines.en: Perhaps because someone was willing to hear me out.

lines.cn: 这把刀跟了我很多年，刀鞘上全是风刮的印子。
lines.en: This blade has been with me for years. The scabbard is scarred by the wind.

lines.cn: 以前我拿它挡人。
lines.en: I used to use it to keep people out.

lines.cn: 以后我想拿它护着一个人。
lines.en: From now on, I want to use it to protect one person.

lines.cn: 灯有人守了，路也有人走了。
lines.en: Someone tends the lamps now. People walk the road again.

lines.cn: 我这个守路的，也想有个地方能回。
lines.en: Even an old road guard wants somewhere to come home to.

positiveBubbles.en: Well chosen. I will put it to good use.

negativeBubbles.cn: 心意收到了，这件暂时用不上。
negativeBubbles.en: Thank you for thinking of me. I have no use for this right now.

normalBubbles.en: Thank you. I will keep it.

lines.cn: 路归路，人归人。你肯坐下，我也能听。热饭和趁手的兵器，我都珍惜。
lines.en: The road is one matter; you are another. Sit down and I will listen. I value a hot meal and a dependable weapon.

lines.cn: 脚步我认得，不用再报名字。
lines.en: I know your footsteps. No need to give your name.

lines.cn: 灯有人守了。今天，我先陪你。
lines.en: Someone else can watch the lamp. Today I will stay with you.

idle.cn: 旧事不必替我扛。把眼前的路走稳就好。
idle.en: You do not have to carry my past. Keep your footing on the road ahead.

levelUp.cn: 与你相处，越来越自在了。
levelUp.en: I feel more at ease with you now.

farewell.cn: 这回不拦你。累了就回来，我在。
farewell.en: I will not bar your way. Come home when you are tired. I will be here.

alreadyGifted.cn: 今天已经收到你的礼物了。
alreadyGifted.en: You have already given me a gift today.

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: 今天这份够了，你也留些给自己。
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: That is plenty for today. Keep some for yourself.

alreadyGiftedNormal.cn: 礼物收好了，今天不必再送。
alreadyGiftedNormal.en: Your gift is safe. No need for another today.

alreadyGiftedNegative.en: Let us leave it there for today.

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: 你回来了。门没闩，一直给你留着。
dialogue_greeting_married.en: You are back. I left the door unlatched for you.

dialogue_idle_married.cn: 旧事不必替我扛。把眼前的路走稳就好。
dialogue_idle_married.en: You do not have to carry my past. Keep your footing on the road ahead.

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: 这回不拦你。累了就回来，我在。
dialogue_farewell_married.en: I will not bar your way. Come home when you are tired. I will be here.

dialogue_after_gift_married.en: It is good to know you are thinking of me.

gift_positive_married.en: Well chosen. I will put it to good use.

gift_normal_married.cn: 我收好了。下回也给你带一份。
gift_normal_married.en: I will keep it safe. Next time I will bring something for you too.

lines.cn: （他看见你来，把铜牌上的旧字擦掉，空出一块地方。）
lines.en: (He sees you coming, wipes the old words off his brass plate, and leaves a clean space.)

lines.cn: （他写：你常来。）
lines.en: (He writes: You come often.)

lines.cn: （他想了想，又添一行：钟声太吵的那些年，我就不说话了。）
lines.en: (He thinks, then adds a line: In the years the bell was too loud, I stopped talking.)

lines.cn: （他指指自己的喉咙，摇摇头，又指指铜牌。）
lines.en: (He points to his throat, shakes his head, and points to the plate.)

lines.cn: （铜牌上写：这样也好。你说，我写。）
lines.en: (The plate reads: This works too. You talk, I write.)

lines.cn: （他从怀里摸出一块很旧的铜牌，边角都磨圆了。）
lines.en: (He takes a very old brass plate from his coat. Its corners are worn round.)

lines.cn: （上面刻满了名字，一行挨一行，有的已经看不清。）
lines.en: (It is covered in names, row after row. Some are too faint to read.)

lines.cn: （他写：出海没回来的人，我都刻在这里。）
lines.en: (He writes: Everyone who sailed out and never came back, I carved here.)

lines.cn: （他写：钟每响一次，我就怕又要多刻一个。）
lines.en: (He writes: Every time the bell rang, I feared I would carve one more.)

lines.cn: （他把旧铜牌收回怀里，在新牌上写：你的名字，我不想刻在那块上。）
lines.en: (He tucks the old plate away and writes on the new one: I do not want your name on that one.)

lines.cn: （他在铜牌一角，画了一口很小的钟。）
lines.en: (In a corner of the plate, he draws a very small bell.)

lines.cn: （他写：以后你在外面听见钟声——）
lines.en: (He writes: From now on, if you hear a bell out there—)

lines.cn: （他停了停，接着写：就当是我在叫你回来。）
lines.en: (He pauses, then continues: think of it as me calling you home.)

lines.cn: （他看了一会儿，把「叫你回来」划掉，改成「等你」。）
lines.en: (He looks at it for a while, crosses out "calling you home," and writes "waiting for you.")

lines.cn: （他把铜牌转过来给你看，有点不好意思地挠了挠头。）
lines.en: (He turns the plate around to show you and scratches his head, a little embarrassed.)

lines.cn: （他把铜牌擦得很亮，亮得能照见你。）
lines.en: (He has polished the brass plate so bright you can see yourself in it.)

lines.cn: （他写：守钟的人，本来只该等船。）
lines.en: (He writes: A bell keeper is only supposed to wait for ships.)

lines.cn: （他写：后来，我只等一个人。）
lines.en: (He writes: Then I started waiting for one person.)

lines.cn: （他把你的手按在铜牌上，在旁边写：回来了，就敲一下钟。）
lines.en: (He places your hand on the plate and writes beside it: When you come back, ring the bell once.)

lines.cn: （他写：我听得见。）
lines.en: (He writes: I will hear it.)

positiveBubbles.cn: （他轻轻点头，把礼物放进贴身的小盒。）
positiveBubbles.en: (He nods and puts your gift in the little box he keeps close.)

negativeBubbles.cn: （他点头收下，在铜牌上写下：谢谢。）
negativeBubbles.en: (He accepts it with a nod and writes: Thank you.)

normalBubbles.cn: （他点头收下，在铜牌上写下：谢谢。）
normalBubbles.en: (He accepts it with a nod and writes: Thank you.)

lines.cn: （他在铜片上写下：坐。带残铜片、星屑或晴岚风晶来，都能用。）
lines.en: (He writes on a brass sheet: Sit. Brass scrap, stardust or Qinglan windcrystal can all be used.)

lines.cn: （他把身旁的椅子往你这边挪了挪。）
lines.en: (He moves the chair beside him a little closer to you.)

lines.cn: （他写道：听见你的脚步，就不必等钟声了。）
lines.en: (He writes: Your footsteps are enough. I no longer need to wait for the bell.)

idle.cn: （他擦净铜牌，留下一小块给你写字。）
idle.en: (He polishes the brass plate and leaves a small space for your words.)

afterGift.cn: （他点头，把今天收到的礼物仔细收好。）
afterGift.en: (He nods and carefully puts away today's gift.)

levelUp.cn: （他点头，把今天收到的礼物仔细收好。）
levelUp.en: (He nods and carefully puts away today's gift.)

farewell.cn: （他握了一下你的手，指向牌上的字：我等你。）
farewell.en: (He squeezes your hand and points to the words on the plate: I will wait for you.)

alreadyGifted.cn: （他点头，把今天收到的礼物仔细收好。）
alreadyGifted.en: (He nods and carefully puts away today's gift.)

alreadyGiftedPositive.cn: （他点头，把今天收到的礼物仔细收好。）
alreadyGiftedPositive.en: (He nods and carefully puts away today's gift.)

alreadyGiftedNormal.cn: （他点头，把今天收到的礼物仔细收好。）
alreadyGiftedNormal.en: (He nods and carefully puts away today's gift.)

alreadyGiftedNegative.cn: （他点头，把今天收到的礼物仔细收好。）
alreadyGiftedNegative.en: (He nods and carefully puts away today's gift.)

dialogue_greeting_married.cn: （门边的铜牌写着：欢迎回家。旁边留了你的名字。）
dialogue_greeting_married.en: (The brass plate by the door reads: Welcome home. Your name is written beside it.)

dialogue_idle_married.cn: （他擦净铜牌，留下一小块给你写字。）
dialogue_idle_married.en: (He polishes the brass plate and leaves a small space for your words.)

dialogue_farewell_married.cn: （他握了一下你的手，指向牌上的字：我等你。）
dialogue_farewell_married.en: (He squeezes your hand and points to the words on the plate: I will wait for you.)

dialogue_after_gift_married.cn: （他轻握你的手，在铜牌上写下：谢谢。）
dialogue_after_gift_married.en: (He holds your hand and writes: Thank you.)

gift_positive_married.cn: （他轻轻点头，把礼物放进贴身的小盒。）
gift_positive_married.en: (He nods and puts your gift in the little box he keeps close.)

gift_normal_married.cn: （他把礼物放好，写道：有你就好。）
gift_normal_married.en: (He puts the gift away and writes: I am glad you are here.)

marriage_chapel_required.cn: （他在铜牌上写：先把教堂建好。）
marriage_chapel_required.en: (He writes on the brass plate: Build the chapel first.)

marriage_divorce.en: (He lowers the brass plate and nods once.)

marriage_bubble_date.en: (The brass plate gains a new line: {date}.)

marriage_cheat_first.cn: （他看着你，把铜牌翻了过去，这次没有写字。）
marriage_cheat_first.en: (He looks at you and turns the brass plate face down. Not a word this time.)

marriage_cheat_repeat.en: (He strikes the bell once, very softly.)

marriage_follow_refused.en: (He points at the plate: I keep the bell today.)

ring_reject.cn: （他摇了摇头，把戒指推了回来。）
ring_reject.en: (He shakes his head and pushes the ring back.)

ring_cheater.cn: （他在铜牌上写：有家的人，别乱送。）
ring_cheater.en: (He writes: You have a home already. Don't hand these out.)

ring_spouse_repeat.cn: （他按住你的手，写下：一枚够了。）
ring_spouse_repeat.en: (He presses your hand and writes: One is enough.)
